title: Servo Control

hints.title: How to get a servo from the hardware map
hints.content: Use `Servo myServo = hardwareMap.get(Servo.class, "testServo");` -- the pattern is the same as motors, just with `Servo.class` instead of `DcMotor.class`.

hints.title: How to set servo position
hints.content: Call `myServo.setPosition(1.0);` to move to the maximum position, or `myServo.setPosition(0.0);` for the minimum. The value must be between 0.0 and 1.0.

hints.title: Checking button presses
hints.content: Gamepad buttons are boolean fields. Use `if (gamepad1.a)` to check if the A button is currently pressed. No `== true` needed -- the field is already a boolean.
